content:
Stack Interchange with elevated rotary design using Autodesk InfraWorks and Twinmotion.

InfraWorks used for conceptual design and 3D infrastructure modeling while Twinmotion bring the design to life through realistic visualization and rendering.

The integration of road design, 3D modeling and visualization to present complex infrastructure concepts in a clear way.

Credit: JD Intro Theme | Master Mash-up | Thalapathy | Anirudh

#CivilEngineering #HighwayDesign #StackInterchange #InfraWorks #Twinmotion #InfrastructureDesign #3DVisualization #TransportationEngineering #BIM #RoadDesign #InterchangeDesign #ElevatedRotary
comment: The real test is how the geometry performs under peak-hour demand. Weaving movements, ramp spacing, sight distance and queue spillback can make or break an elevated rotary long before the visuals reveal it.
